title: Analytics and AI for Utilities: Unlocking Efficiency and Reliability
content: The utility industry is facing challenges to increase operational efficiency, reduce costs, enhance reliability, and integrate renewable and distributed energy resources (DERs) onto the grid. Utilities are experimenting with approaches to intelligently use the vast amount of data they have using advanced analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning (ML) techniques.

Amanda Mastrosimone,
